title: CONSIDER: A. APPROVING the use of $1 million of previously deobligated local Proposition C 25% Call for Projects funding set aside in reserve for capital…
text:
[Metro Board file 2026-0583, Program]
[EXECUTIVE MANAGEMENT COMMITTEE MADE THE FOLLOWING RECOMMENDATION (3-0):]
CONSIDER:

A.	APPROVING the use of $1 million of previously deobligated local Proposition C 25% Call for Projects funding set aside in reserve for capital projects to fund Open and Slow Streets Cycle 8 operational events between September 2026 and March 2028;

B.	AMENDING the FY27 Budget by $1,000,000 to authorize expenditures for Recommendation A; and

C.	AUTHORIZING the Chief Executive Officer or their designee to award eligible Cycle 8 events that meet the requirements and process outlined in Attachment A.
summary: Approving the use of $1 million in Proposition C funding for Open and Slow Streets Cycle 8 operational events between September 2026 and March 2028, and amending the FY27 budget to authorize the expenditure.

details.action: Funding allocation for Open and Slow Streets program

flag.reason: Funds the next round of Open and Slow Streets events (CicLAvia-style street closures) through March 2028.
